    AI Overview
    The 2026 Masters Tournament begins its first round on Thursday, April 9, with the honorary starters (Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus, Tom Watson) at 7:25 a.m. ET, followed by the first tee times at 7:40 a.m. ET. The second round on Friday, April 10, also starts at 7:40 a.m. ET. 
    Key 2026 Masters Start Times (ET): 
    • Thursday, April 9 (Round 1): First tee times start at 7:40 a.m. ET.
    • Friday, April 10 (Round 2): First tee times start at 7:40 a.m. ET.
    • Saturday, April 11 (Round 3): Tee times begin around 10:30 a.m. ET.
    • Sunday, April 12 (Round 4): Final round tee times start around 10:30 a.m. ET. 
    How to Watch: 
    • TV Coverage (Thurs/Fri): 3-7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
    • TV Coverage (Sat/Sun): 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
    • Streaming: Featured groups begin earlier via Masters.com and Paramount+. 
    Note: Times are approximate and subject to weather delays.
